prompt.generated_prompt_string: A dreamy pastel fashion editorial of an adult woman seated naturally inside a luxury glass elevator. She wears a mauve-pink lace blouse with a high neckline and a matching midi skirt, with pearl jewelry, pink gemstone earrings, and a small pink handbag. She sits comfortably on a white high-pile faux-fur rug with knees angled to one side, one hand resting gently near her cheek, and a calm reflective expression. Clusters of pink, mint, yellow, and pale-blue balloons fill the glass elevator. Use a high-angle balanced composition, soft warm ambient light, controlled glass reflections, natural skin texture, detailed lace, and a polished celebration mood.
